[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of individual two (2)-year Multiple Award Task Order Contracts to [i] 9th Wonder Global LLC dba Gravity Global, [ii] Actum LLC, [iii] Amanecer Consulting Group LLC, [iv] Brown Marketing Strategies dba CENTRIC, [v] Cielo Strategic Communications, [vi] Jon Schmid dba Cook + Schmid LLC, [vii] Dakota Communications, [viii] Fraser/White Inc. dba Fraser Communications, [ix] Ignited LLC, [x] IPG DXTRA Inc. dba Weber Shandwick, [xi] Lee Andrews Group, [xii] Highstake 35 LLC dba Mercury Public Affairs, [xiii] Murakawa Communications Inc., [xiv] PLAYING, and [xv] Sensis: With a one (1)-year renewal option, covering as-needed comprehensive communications, public relations, and marketing services for Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, for total combined authority not to exceed $3,000,000 (Erin Trapp)
summary: Two-year on-call contracts with 15 communications, public relations and marketing firms for LAX and Van Nuys, with a combined spending cap of $3 million and a one-year renewal option.
